name: normalize-svg
description: Flattens arbitrary SVG into a minimal subset — CSS, <use>, nested <svg> and shapes all become plain <path> — via usvg compiled to WebAssembly. Fonts for text and emoji are embedded, so output is identical on every OS with no font downloads.
author: Attila Tóth

scripts.build:native: RUSTFLAGS="-C link-arg=-zstack-size=8388608 --remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=/cargo --remap-path-prefix=$(rustc --print sysroot)=/rust" wasm-pack build . --release --target nodejs --out-dir pkg --out-name normalize_svg
scripts.verify: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- pkg/ && npm test && npm run smoke
